props.name: shape
props.description: Which regular 4-polytope to draw. The built-in control can change it; `onShapeChange` reports that.

props.name: onShapeChange
props.description: Called when the built-in shape control picks another polytope.

props.name: projection
props.description: 4D → 3D projection: a perspective eye on the w axis, or stereographic from the 3-sphere's pole, which bends edges into arcs.

props.name: onProjectionChange
props.description: Called when the built-in projection control changes.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Controlled orientation, radians per plane. When set, the component draws exactly this and reports turns through `onRotationChange`.

props.name: defaultRotation
props.description: Uncontrolled starting orientation, radians per plane. Planes left out take the built-in three-quarter view.

props.name: onRotationChange
props.description: Called when a drag, key, wheel or slider turns it. Not called for the automatic spin.

props.name: spin
props.description: Spin speed per plane, radians per second. Defaults to xw and yw in the golden ratio, plus a slow xz drift.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Spin on its own. Ignored under reduced motion and when `rotation` is controlled.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the spin and any momentum. Dragging still turns it.

props.name: eye
props.description: Perspective only: distance of the 4D eye along w, in circumradii (above 1). Closer exaggerates it — the inner cell shrinks.

props.name: cells
props.description: Fill the 2-faces (the squares of the tesseract's eight cubes, and so on) as translucent polygons, sorted back to front.

props.name: vertices
props.description: Draw a dot on every vertex, sized by nearness in w.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag, arrow keys and (while focused) the wheel turn it.

props.name: dragPlanes
props.description: What a plain drag turns. Shift swaps to the other pair while held.

props.name: tone
props.description: Edge colour: ink far in w blending to accent near (`duo`), or a single token.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum width in pixels. The view is square and fills its container up to this.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the shape, projection and display controls, and the per-plane sliders whenever it is still.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, followed by a generated description of the shape and its orientation. An empty string makes the picture decorative.
